title: kbext.py verify fails a leak_scan extender whose function is not named file_hits, and that FAIL line names no point, module or layer
goal: kbext.py verify calls a leak_scan extender by the attribute its setting names, whatever its name, as kbpublic.file_hits does; every FAIL line it prints names the point, the module and the layer

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
e=T/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"gleak.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=0.1\"\ndef scan(path, text, allow, pinned=()):\n    return 5\n")
(T/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"leak_scan":"gleak:scan"},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","verify","--root",str(T)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
fails=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("FAIL")]
if r.returncode!=1 or not fails:
    sys.exit("not yet: expected a FAIL for a scan that answers a non-list: "+repr((r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)))
bad=[l for l in fails if not ("leak_scan" in l and "gleak" in l and "clone" in l)]
sys.exit("not yet: a FAIL line misses the point, module or layer: "+repr(bad) if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: every FAIL line it prints names the point, the module and the layer
